parsed.explanation: Worst documented feature is state-tolerated predation on visibly trans people: police extortion, retaliatory beatings (12 injured, Sept 2025), arrests of hijras at a major airport and on street livelihoods, with no anti-discrimination law, no hate-crime recourse, and police themselves the perpetrators — the ladder's tier 2, plus a documented lethal-violence pattern (advocate murdered Feb 2025, perpetrators unidentified) and a rising national violation trend amid post-2024 Islamist mobilisation. Section 377 is a secondary lever, used to bully gender-nonconforming people rather than prosecuted; it is not the dominant factor. Offsetting climate signals — official third-gender recognition since 2013, gender-marker change, hijra voter option, an elected trans mayor, pride events, cultural familiarity — are real but resident-facing and coexist with documented severe discrimination. Critically, no traveller-facing universal exposure is documented: no border/document friction, no facility ban, no custody rule. Hence above the 0.25–0.35 police-coercion profiles, below the 0.45 unremedied-universal-exposure tier.
